task: TAX LIEN INSIGHT — Backend-only production implementation
approach: Backend built as an independently deployable Node/TypeScript/PostgreSQL service under backend/. The existing TanStack Start frontend is unchanged; its /api/v1 routes now proxy to the backend service. The legacy in-browser mock (src/integrations/firebase/mock.ts) is preserved untouched.
migrationsCreated: 0002_schema.sql (auctions, bidding, financial, usdc, payments, certificates, redemption, kyc, documents, communications, admin, search/watchlist)
0005_awards.sql (awards/award_events tables, users.email_verified_at/last_login_at, funds_accounts.status, user status alignment incl. pending_verification/closed)
authenticationImplementation: DB-backed sessions (sessions table, sha token hash, IP/user-agent, expiry, revocation) + signed HS256 cookie via jose. Passwords hashed with bcrypt (12 rounds). Email verification tokens, password reset tokens, login attempt logging, secure one-time admin bootstrap via ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET (disabled after first use). RBAC: roles + permissions tables, user_roles, role_permissions; server-side requirePermission/requireAdmin checks on every protected endpoint.
emailImplementation: EmailProvider interface with ResendEmailProvider (used when RESEND_API_KEY set) and OutboxEmailProvider fallback that persists to email_outbox and logs NOT_CONFIGURED. Templates: welcome, verification, password_reset, bid_confirmation, outbid, auction_reminder, winning, losing, payment, invoice, certificate, redemption, support, saved_search. Business logic never hard-codes provider.
financialImplementation: Authoritative funds_accounts (available/held/pending) + immutable ledger_entries (DB trigger rejects UPDATE/DELETE). fund_holds for bid holds with active/released/consumed states. All balance moves inside SERIALIZABLE transactions with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE row locks. money stored as BIGINT cents, never floats. Idempotency keys on ledger/holds/bids/deposits. profiles.account_balance preserved but deprecated (derived from ledger; not user-writable).
usdcImplementation: crypto_deposits model with independent on-chain verification via BlockchainProvider abstraction. Never trusts user-supplied tx hash: verifies network, token contract (vs configured USDC contract), recipient (deposit address), amount, and confirmation threshold before crediting ledger. Duplicate tx hash guard. Unconfigured provider fails safely (NOT_CONFIGURED).
certificateImplementation: issueCertificate (number + verification token/hash + document), verifyCertificate (public safe-fields only, optional token check, 403 on bad token, 410 on revoked), revokeCertificate (state + audit), generateCertificateDocument (HTML stored via storage provider; PDF generation pending a PDF library).
redemptionImplementation: calculateRedemption uses jurisdiction rules effective at sale date (snapshot) + time-proportional interest; no single hard-coded formula. State machine (not_started..completed) with amount validation (REDEMPTION_INCORRECT_AMOUNT) and certificate status update on completion.
kycImplementation: KycProvider abstraction (unconfigured safe). kyc_verifications/kyc_documents/kyc_events records. submitKyc + reviewKyc (approve/reject updates profiles.kyc_status + audit). No fake successful verification.
adminAuthorizationImplementation: RBAC roles/permissions; every admin endpoint requires requireAdmin or specific permission (kyc.review, funds.view, certificate.revoke, redemption.manage, audit.view, user.suspend, auction.*, property.*). Audited via audit_logs + admin_actions. 403 returned for non-admins (not hidden data).
testsCreated: backend/tests/unit-rules.test.ts (rate alignment/increments, money-as-cents, auction state machine, error-code contract)
backend/tests/integration.test.ts (DB-gated suites A/B/C: auth+authorization, auction lifecycle+bidding concurrency+awards-on-finalize, funds+USDC+certificates+redemptions+documents)
testsSummary: 16/16 runnable tests pass (vitest). 11 integration tests are DB-gated: they auto-skip unless DATABASE_URL points at a reachable PostgreSQL and cover register/verify/login, permission enforcement, concurrent bid serialization (exactly one winner), award creation on finalize, USDC ledger crediting, certificate verification, redemption creation and owner-scoped document URLs.
unresolvedExternalIntegrations: Resend email (set RESEND_API_KEY to enable; otherwise outbox fallback, NOT_CONFIGURED)
Blockchain RPC / USDC verification (set BLOCKCHAIN_RPC_URL; otherwise unconfigured, deposits cannot be confirmed)
KYC provider (Persona/Onfido/etc.; currently unconfigured — submissions recorded, verification pending provider)
Object storage (set OBJECT_STORAGE_* for S3; otherwise local-dev storage, NOT for production)
PDF certificate rendering (HTML document generated; PDF pipeline pending a pdf library)

deployment.target: Cloudflare Workers (backend) + Cloudflare Pages/Workers (frontend) + Neon PostgreSQL
deployment.dbRuntimeStrategy: db/pool.ts is runtime-adaptive: @neondatabase/serverless (WebSocket pool) on Cloudflare Workers — full interactive-transaction support preserved; node-postgres on Node/CLI/tests
deployment.pgIsolationOnWorkers: wrangler.jsonc aliases pg -> src/db/pg-unavailable.ts so node-postgres is never bundled into the Worker
deployment.workerBundleDryRun: PASS (wrangler deploy --dry-run: 696.12 KiB / gzip 150.17 KiB; stub verified present, no pg internals bundled)
deployment.migration0006: settlement categories on ledger_entries + partial unique index preventing duplicate USDC credits per (network_code, token_contract, transaction_hash)
deployment.settlementDestinations: USDC_SETTLEMENT_ADDRESS_PLATFORM / USDC_SETTLEMENT_ADDRESS_PROCEEDS env config — platform revenue never conflated with auction proceeds

notes: Frontend pages still read from the legacy mock; they were NOT wired to the new backend in this phase per the backend-only directive. The full /api/v1 surface is exposed by the standalone backend (npm run dev in backend/) and proxied through the TanStack app. To connect the UI later, swap the mock client for calls to /api/v1. Registration now creates accounts as pending_verification; login is refused until email verification completes. Run `npm run admin:bootstrap` (requires ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET, optional ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD) to create the first super_admin — it refuses once any super_admin exists. Invoice payment debits through an immutable ledger entry inside a transaction (row-locked invoice + account), never a raw balance write.
